message: Result entry now shows the current competition's fastest three single-race times for the exact round, course and group; Race Off and Swiss/knockout show the actual pairing opponent time only for racer two. The course record sits beside LOCATION. Car PB is still retained in Records and post-race notices, but hidden from result entry. No cumulative championship positions are used; no racing data or campaign state is modified by this UI update. Portable Backup recommended.
